topics.title: Piano Jam and Extreme Weather
topics.summary: During a radio show, Scott improvises piano segments while discussing heat waves in Texas and a devastating tidal wave in Papua New Guinea. The hosts explore survival strategies like refrigeration and surfing alongside commentary on the high death toll from extreme temperatures.

topics.title: New Guinea Disaster & Presidential Investigation
topics.summary: Following a devastating wall-of-water event in New Guinea, over two thousand people remain missing amidst widespread devastation including wiped villages. Amidst this crisis, investigations continue regarding President Clinton’s relationship with Monica Lewinsky, delaying testimony and featuring commentary on related figures like Robert Bork.

topics.title: Tile Obsession and Health Care Concerns
topics.summary: During this broadcast, individuals discuss an obsession with tiling areas like women's legs, finding it sexually stimulating. Simultaneously, concerns arise about a new city ordinance restricting strip club attire to full bathing suit bottoms and t-shirts due to proposed health care tracking systems raising privacy worries.

topics.title: Magic Show Mishap and a Million Dollar Car
topics.summary: During a magic show, an audience member attempts to get under an assistant while Robin makes crude comments about ‘catching a wolf.’ Later the conversation shifts to a $1 million Prince Charles engagement gift car that its owner is refusing to sell, followed by news of a skydiver’s death during a world record attempt.

topics.title: De Niro Theater Troubles
topics.summary: During an audience member’s visit, Robert De Niro complains about uncomfortable theater seats and escalating arguments with two other patrons resembling Beavis and Butthead. He moves the offending seats to the side of the theatre while discussing movie preferences like ‘Something About Mary,’ Antonio Banderas' role in 'The Mask of Zorro,' and a bizarre conversation regarding Catherine Zeta-Jones’ potential adoption plans.

topics.title: Wedding Singer Ticket Troubles and Fart Facts
topics.summary: During a segment about the movie ‘The Wedding Singer,’ callers discuss Adam Sandler’s appearance while attempting to win pumpkin concert tickets for their twelve-year-old children, expressing concerns about attending with an adult. Later, scientists explain methane gas exposure from coworkers can weaken immune systems.
